name: Acadia National Park
agency: NPS Acadia GIS, USGS 3DEP & OpenStreetMap Contributors
summary: Pink granite peaks rising straight from the Atlantic Ocean, historic iron-rung cliff trails, and glacial lakes.

trails.name: The Beehive & The Bowl Loop
trails.condition_note: Iron rungs dry; not suitable for dogs or acrophobia.
trails.description: Climbs exposed granite cliff ledges using historic iron rungs to panoramic views over Sand Beach and the Gulf of Maine, descending past The Bowl.

trails.name: Jordan Pond Shore Path Loop
trails.condition_note: Cedar boardwalk on west shore in excellent condition.
trails.description: Level shoreline loop ringing crystal-clear Jordan Pond with classic views of The Bubbles.

trails.name: Cadillac Mountain North Ridge Trail
trails.condition_note: Open pink granite slabs with constant Frenchman Bay views.
trails.description: Ascends open pink granite ridges to the 1,530-ft summit of Cadillac Mountain, the highest point along the North Atlantic seaboard.

trails.name: Cadillac South Ridge to Jordan Pond Connector
trails.condition_note: Long open ridge walk connecting Cadillac summit and Jordan Pond.
trails.description: Traverses the long granite spine of Cadillac's South Ridge down toward Jordan Pond House.

pois.name: The Beehive Summit (520 ft)
pois.note: Panoramic overlook of Sand Beach & Great Head

pois.name: Jordan Pond House Trailhead
pois.note: Water, restrooms, and Island Explorer bus stop

pois.name: Cadillac Mountain Summit (1,530 ft)
pois.note: Highest peak on Mount Desert Island
